title: Evaluating AI Agents Before Production: What Catches Real Failures
excerpt: A support agent can refund a customer twice and still produce a perfectly correct final answer. Here's how to test the path it took, not just where it landed.
seo_title: Evaluating AI Agents Before Production (2026 Guide)
meta_description: A practical guide to evaluating AI agents before production: grade the trajectory, not just the output, with LangChain AgentEvals and Anthropic's eval guide.
social_message:
My AI agent refunded the same customer twice, and its final answer was still 100% correct.

Turns out a correct final answer tells you nothing about whether the steps behind it were safe. I tested this with LangChain's AgentEvals and found a match mode that completely misses duplicate tool calls.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/evaluating-ai-agents-before-production/
